svg.text: Heavy arrows are region hand-offs; the cyan one is the HTTP response. Light arrows are steps inside a region. There is no green rail because this module has no Redis.
Ownership is enforced inside the update filter rather than by a separate lookup, so a cross-account edit simply matches nothing and returns 404.
